hero.eyebrow: LS — Cooperative Precision Layer for AI Co-work
hero.title: LS turns AI work into reviewed goals, skills, decisions, and evidence you own.
hero.subtitle: Use an AI session, check what it actually changed, accept only the updates you trust, and keep a private growth trail instead of another forgotten chat.

grant.title: A concrete evidence stack for safe AI-assisted human development
grant.subtitle: The Personal Cognitive Garden asks whether AI sessions can compound into useful, human-owned development memory without becoming surveillance, opaque scoring, or unauthorized profiling.

cards.title: Reproducible evidence
cards.body: A one-command evidence bundle, runnable demo, JSON reports, and regression tests make the claim inspectable instead of purely conceptual.

cards.title: Evaluation surface
cards.body: The v0.2 harness separates support, admin work, execution, learning, capital-compounding, and noise while tracking false-positive and false-negative risks.

cards.title: Safety boundary
cards.body: A red-team suite, privacy model, and pilot protocol test that private cognitive graphs remain human-owned and non-surveillance by default.

plugin.title: Turn Codex and Cowork into a governed quality system
plugin.subtitle: LS adds the layer raw agents miss: catch broken context, hold risky actions, turn useful sessions into growth proposals, and keep the final decision with the human.
plugin.flowBody: Fewer blind continuations. Fewer raw answers. More reviewable decisions you can show a team, reviewer, or investor.

items.title: Stop false continuation
items.body: When an agent says it will continue from that PR, LS checks whether the PR, branch, diff, and review conclusion are actually present.

items.title: Review before sending
items.body: Route Claude, Kimi, Codex, a local model, or phone-chat draft through LS before the answer reaches the user.

items.title: Turn sessions into skill capital
items.body: Useful work does not disappear into chat history: LS turns it into a private growth proposal that only saves after human consent.

items.title: Produce a trust report
items.body: Show the log: what was proposed, accepted, rejected, and why LS held continuation or action.

problem.title: AI adoption is measured by activity, not human development

items.centralized: Teams can count usage, tokens, tasks, and output, but cannot easily tell whether people are becoming more capable.
items.size: A stronger model does not automatically create stronger human skill; it can also hide weak reasoning or create dependency.
items.hallucinations: Agent inferences about skills, goals, or weaknesses can become opaque memory unless they are evidence-backed and reviewed.
items.memory: Useful sessions disappear into chat history instead of compounding into a durable, human-owned development graph.

problem.solutionBody: LS classifies AI sessions by developmental effect, extracts evidence-backed skill deltas, requires human review, and commits only accepted updates into a private cognitive graph.

local.title: Human-owned graph
local.desc: Goals, skills, decisions, evidence, and growth paths remain under the person's control by default.

causal.title: Evidence-backed claims
causal.desc: Skill-growth claims require supporting artifacts and can be accepted, rejected, or revised by the person.

human.title: Development classification
human.desc: Sessions are separated into administrative, emotional support, execution, skill-building, capital-compounding, and noise classes.

anti.title: Anti-surveillance boundary
anti.desc: Private graph export requests are blocked; only consented, non-sensitive, aggregate-safe signals may be shared externally.

identity.title: Reproducible demo
identity.desc: The repository includes schema, examples, accepted graph state, and a local runner for reviewer inspection.

runtime.title: From raw AI sessions to reviewed capability growth

problem.title: Problem
problem.body: AI sessions increasingly shape learning, coding, research, and decisions, but most systems do not distinguish useful activity from durable human development.

solution.title: Solution
solution.body: LS turns sessions into proposed development updates: classify the session, identify skill deltas, require evidence, and let the person accept or reject the graph change.
